subject: Workplace Skills
title: Knowing When to Leave
description: A quick win: understand Knowing When to Leave.

hook.text: She stayed three years in a toxic environment waiting for it to improve. It never did.

buildup.text: Some political environments are fixable. Others are fundamental to the culture and will not change.

discovery.text: The signal is when your values are consistently violated and leadership reinforces harmful behavior.

twist.text: Leaving is not failure. It is a strategic decision to invest your career capital in healthier ground.

climax.text: Plan your exit while still employed. Leave gracefully and maintain every relationship you can.

punchline.text: Leave before the environment changes you.

quiz.question: When should you consider leaving a politically toxic workplace?
options: After any single disagreement with management
When your values are consistently violated and leadership reinforces it
Only if you already have a better offer
